caseNameFull: Kate P. McNaughton v. W. D. Stephens, Governor of the State of California
summary: Appeal , from the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of California.
attorneys: Mr. Tom L. Johnston and Mr. James H. - Longden for appellant., Mr. U. S. Webb, Mr. Robert M. Clarke, Mr. Thomas Lee Woolwine and Mr. Clifford P. Smith for appellees.
